"The leftist is oriented toward largescale collectivism. He emphasizes the
duty of the individual to serve society and the duty of society to take care
of the individual. He has a negative attitude toward individualism. He often
takes a moralistic tone. He tends to be for gun control, for sex education
and other psychologically 'enlightened' educational methods, for planning,
for affirmative action, for multiculturalism. He tends to identify with
victims. He tends to be against competition and against violence, but he
often finds excuses for those leftists who do commit violence. He is fond of
using the common catch-phrases of the left like 'racism, ' 'sexism,'
'homophobia,' 'capitalism,' 'imperialism,' 'neocolonialism,' 'genocide,'
'social change,' 'social justice,' 'social responsibility.' Maybe the best
diagnostic trait of the leftist is his tendency to sympathize with the
following movements: feminism, gay rights, ethnic rights, disability rights,
animal rights, political correctness. Anyone who strongly sympathizes with
ALL of these movements is almost certainly a leftist." (Paragraph 229)

If I was guaranteed a politically incorrect world without technology, I
would gladly accept it.  I would surrender my predilection for technology if
I could live in a world with more honesty and freedom.

This world has gotten really distorted.  People are so FUCKED UP.  Everyone,
it seems, is wallowing is self-pity.  People seem to enjoy IDENTIFYING
themselves with historical atrocities and injustices, and with groups
perceived as weak.  Strength and virtue are not valued in our society.

I was watching television about a couple of months ago and it was watching a
program about the situation in Yugoslavia.  What did they do?  They brought
survivors of the "Holocaust" to talk about what was occuring.  Of course,
the Jewish holocaust survivors talked about how horrible it must be and how
they hoped the situation could be resolved for the Albanians.   But why the
fuck did they have to bring Jews on the air?  What is happening in
Yugoslavia and the Jewish holocaust (which was a far greater atrocity) had
less in common that what is happening in the Balkans and what the
Palestinians have gone through.  The analogy doesn't fit.  As terrible as
the Jewish holocaust was, it fits more with the internment of the Japanese
on our soil during WW2 (and would have fit even better if the food supply
had been cut therefore creating starvation diets, and if there were some
executions, ovens, forced labor, and typhus [which Anne Frank died of]).

What they should have had was Palestinians talking about what it's like to
be forced to flee one's homeland.  This nation is so hypocritical.  We go to
Yugoslavia and tell the Serbs to stop bullying the Albanians -- which then
leads to massive expulsions -- while funneling billions of dollars annually
to a nation which has committed far worse crimes than the Serbs.  Many Jews
I have spoken to see Israel as a state of the U.S.  Without America's
support the last state which openly endorses apartheid, Israel, would have
been gobbled up by the Arabs long ago.  And we have the nerve to charge
Milosevic with war crimes?

Anyhow, I admit, what the Jews experienced during WW2 was very serious.
Millions died.  But I do NOT feel sorry for them.  I have read history (no,
I'm not a history buff) and know they have committed far worse deeds on
other people.  I'm not fooled by the propaganda.  The Jews have oppressed
others for thousands of years with their usury and greed.  The Jew was in
large part behind the starvation of the Ukranians.  The only reason why the
Jew is a symbol of an oppressed being is because he controls the media.
People watch Steven Spielberg's crap and believe it's real.  Americans are
so empty-headed.  Every time there is an atrocity the Jewish holocaust is
brought up.  Why?  What about what led to the "Holocaust"?  What about other
holocausts?  Were the Jews just innocent victims who got caught between a
brick wall and a schizophrenic man with one testicle, who was part Jew, and
was a homosexual with syphilis?  No, Hitler knew how scheming the Jew was;
he knew the Jews (or at least a disproportionate amount of them) wanted to
bring communism to Germany.

Anyhow, I think it's time Jews get off their fucking crosses.  They are not
victims.  They were not expelled 1000 times in history just because they
didn't accept Jesus.  They FUCKING drove millions to the poor house.  Do
they understand that?  They oppressed peasants.  They took advantage of
people when they were desperate.  That's why Shakespeare, and other great
writers, have depicted the Jew so poorly; and why artists such as Richard
Wagner (Hitler's favorite composer) and Franz Linzt despised them.

If Clinton (or any future American president) is going to apologize on
behalf of whites for enslaving blacks, I think the Jews should follow up and
make a formal apology for the acts committed by their filthy ancestors who
owned the slave ships and controlled many aspects of the trade.  I say it
should either be in Washington D.C. or Tel Aviv.  Gerald Levin, the CEO of
Time Warner, Sumner Redstone, the CEO of Viacom, and Michael Eisner, the CEO
of Disney, and the Prime Minister of Israel (whoever it is at the time),
should get together and plan to broadcast an apology to the blacks on prime
time, before a big event like the Super Bowl or at halftime during the NBA
championship games.  It should be DEMANDED by black leaders.  In addition, a
monument commemorating the blacks who died in the Jew slave ships should be
built next to the Holocaust Museum in Washington D.C.  Yes, right next to
it.
